verdict.rationale: Blaxel is a cloud sandbox and compute platform, so attaching GPUs to sandboxed workloads is a fair question for it. None of the evidence mentions GPUs, accelerators, or GPU-backed sandbox or job configuration. Its documented sandbox features (volumes, regions, images, scale-to-zero) are adjacent and do not count as GPU support.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attach GPUs to sandboxed workloads
